habilidades.descricao: Ups fire and psychic in sun.
Ups SP. DEF in calm air.

golpes.descricao: A gentle fairy wind that strikes the foe.
A charming cry that never misses its targets.
A life-stealing kiss that restores the user's HP.
A brilliant fairy flash that hits opposing POKeMON.
Moonlight strikes the foe. It may lower SP. ATK.
Jaci's moonlight falls hard. It may lower SP. ATK.
A regional oath strikes and raises the user's SP. DEF.
A divine eclipse erupts, but lowers the user's SP. ATK.
A stray's starlit charge. It may inflict a burn.
A burst of marsh water that may reduce SPEED.
A hammering stone blow that may lower DEFENSE.
An old wisp-fire that may inflict a burn.
A backward step so quick it always strikes first.
A luring song that may leave the foe confused.
A sudden whirlwind that always strikes first.
A river charm that may leave the foe confused.
A crushing coil that traps the foe for 2 to 5 turns.
A headlong charge that also hurts the user.
A mothering tide that restores the user's HP.
A forged strike that raises the user's DEFENSE.
A serpent's stare that paralyzes the foe.
A dawn that calls harsh sunlight for five turns.
A thunderclap that may leave the foe paralyzed.
An overwhelming current that may reduce SPEED.
A first fire so fierce it also hurts the user.
An ocean swell that may make the foe flinch.
A first-born surge that lowers the user's SP. ATK.
